correctness.rationale: Over \(\mathbb C\), on \(x=1\) set \(u=(TY+1-Z^2)/2\), \(a=u+\mathrm iZ\), \(b=u-\mathrm iZ\), and \(w=F_1/4\). Exact expansion gives \(w=ab-Y^2-1\). Nonzero \(a,Y,w\) have a regular inverse via \(b=(w+Y^2+1)/a\), \(Z=(a-b)/(2\mathrm i)\), \(T=(a+b-1+Z^2)/Y\). Both coordinate systems are regular on their whole domains; mutual identities and \(F_1=4w\) give an isomorphism with the open subset \(U\) defined by the four nonvanishing conditions in the result. Symbolic exact cancellation confirms both compositions. The source proves that \((\mathbb P^3,B)\) is log Calabi–Yau and supplies Theorem 2.9; thus its hypotheses hold for the smooth projective Fano threefold \(\mathbb P^3\).
